create_farming_essentials.ponder.trellis: Right-click the top of farmland with a Stick to plant a Trellis
Right-click the Trellis with melon or pumpkin seeds to plant a vine inside it
The vine grows about twice as fast as it would in the ground
Once fully grown, it produces its fruit on the ground beside the Trellis
Breaking a fully grown Trellis drops its Stick, its seeds and the crop's yield, rolled as if the tool had one extra level of Fortune
A Mechanical Harvester only cuts fully grown Trellises, and does not drop the Stick
create_farming_essentials.ponder.sprinkl: Placed on a floor, a Sprinkler stands upright and takes fluid from the block below it
Placed on the underside of a ceiling, it hangs upside down and takes fluid from the block above it
Placed against a wall, the upper half of the face hangs it from the ceiling and the lower half stands it on the floor
A running Sprinkler reaches a 9x9x9 area
The Sprinkler accepts fluid through its mounting face. Connect Create's pipes to it and it sprays whatever flows in
While fluid is flowing the head spins up and sprays. The fluid itself is used up
Water slowly hydrates farmland in reach, even with no water source nearby
Sprayed water hurts creatures that are sensitive to it, such as Endermen, just like rain does
Other fluids do other things: lava sets creatures alight, and honey slows them down
Other mods can register their own effects for their own fluids
